questions.q: A and B complete a work in 21 days. If A alone can do it in 28 days, then B alone can do three-fourth of the same work in ______________days.
questions.solution:
B’s rate = 1/21 - 1/28 = 1/84 work per day. Three-fourths of the work takes (3/4)/(1/84) = 63 days.
**Answer: 63**

questions.q: Girish scored 441 marks in an examination and was 75 marks short of 30% of maximum marks. In the same examination, his friend scored 688 marks. What is the percentage of marks scored by his friend?
questions.solution:
30% of maximum marks = 441 + 75 = 516, so maximum = 1720. The friend’s percentage is 688/1720 × 100 = 40%.
**Answer: 40%**

questions.q: The common root of $x^2-21x+110=0$ and $110+x-x^2=0$ is:
questions.solution:
The first equation factors as (x - 10)(x - 11) = 0. The second gives (x - 11)(x + 10) = 0 after changing signs. Their common root is 11.
**Answer: 11**

questions.q: The distance between two points on a map is 4 cm. The scale of the map is 1 : 829483. The actual distance between the two points (in km) is: (Round off your answer to two decimal places.)
questions.solution:
Actual length = 4 × 829483 cm. Convert centimetres to kilometres by dividing by 100000: 33.17932 km, rounded to 33.18 km.
**Answer: 33.18**

questions.q: What is the median if the mode of distribution is 48 and the mean is 72?
questions.solution:
Using mode = 3 median - 2 mean, median = (mode + 2 mean)/3 = (48 + 144)/3 = 64.
**Answer: 64**

questions.q: A, B and C together can complete a certain work in 36 days. B and C together can complete the same work in 48 days. B is 75% more efficient than A. A, B and C work together for 15 days. B alone will complete the remaining work in:
questions.solution:
A’s rate = 1/36 - 1/48 = 1/144. B’s rate is 1.75 times this, or 7/576. Remaining work after 15 days is 1 - 15/36 = 7/12. B needs (7/12)/(7/576) = 48 days.
**Answer: 48 days**

questions.q: The number of ordered pair of positive integral solutions (a, b) such that the HCF of a and b is 28 and a + b = 868 is
questions.solution:
Set a = 28x and b = 28y with coprime x and y. Then x + y = 31. Since 31 is prime, all x = 1 to 30 are coprime to 31 - x. There are 30 ordered pairs.
**Answer: 30**

questions.q: The volume of a cylindrical tank is 1584 cubic meters. If the height of the tank is 14 m, then find the diameter of the tank.
questions.solution:
Using π = 22/7, 1584 = πr² × 14 gives r² = 36. Radius = 6 m and diameter = 12 m.
**Answer: 12 m**

questions.q: There are 46 members in group A, 15 members in group B and 11 members in group C. All the members of these groups went to a restaurant. The average amounts spent on each member of groups A, B and C are ₹496, ₹106 and ₹406, respectively. The overall average amount (in ₹) spent per member is:

During a sale 35% of the goods are sold at 22% profit, 40% of the remaining goods are sold at 37% profit and the still remaining goods are sold at a loss of 38%. If there is an overall profit of x%, then what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
The three fractions sold are 0.35, 0.40 × 0.65 = 0.26, and 0.39. Weighted profit = 0.35 × 22 + 0.26 × 37 - 0.39 × 38 = 2.5%.
**Answer: 2.5**

questions.q: Subrata gets double the amount in 8 years when invested at compound interest, compounded annually. In how many years will the amount become eight times itself?
questions.solution:
Eight times the principal equals three successive doublings: 2³. Each doubling takes eight years at the same compound rate, so total time = 3 × 8 = 24 years.
**Answer: 24**

questions.q: In what duration (in years) will ₹8,400 fetch a simple interest of ₹840 at 4% per annum rate of interest?

A geological survey team has established three research stations forming a triangular monitoring zone. The stations are located at coordinates P(2,5), Q(8,1), and R(4,9) on a coordinate grid where each unit represents 1 kilometer. What is the area of the triangular monitoring zone?
questions.solution:
Use half the absolute cross product of PQ = (6, -4) and PR = (2, 4). Area = |6 × 4 - (-4) × 2|/2 = 16 square kilometres.
**Answer: 16 square kilometers**

questions.q: What is the average of 7, 9 and 11?
The ratio of the salaries of A and B is 4 : 5. If A's salary is increased by 20% and B's salary is decreased by 10%, what is the new ratio of their salaries?
questions.solution:
The adjusted salaries are 4 × 1.20 = 4.8 and 5 × 0.90 = 4.5 ratio units. Their ratio is 48 : 45 = 16 : 15.
**Answer: 16 : 15**

questions.q: If a boat travels with a speed of 12 km/hr in still water and the speed of stream is 3 km/hr, what would be the time taken (in hours) by boat to go 60 km downstream?
questions.solution:
Downstream speed = still-water speed + stream speed = 12 + 3 = 15 km/h. Time = 60/15 = 4 hours.
**Answer: 4**

questions.q: PQRS is a cyclic trapezium with PS parallel to QR. If ­ ∠ P = 85°, then the other three angles are:
questions.solution:
Opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral sum to 180°, so R = 95°. With PS parallel to QR, P + Q = 180°, giving Q = 95° and S = 85°.
**Answer: ∠ Q = 95°, ­ ∠ R = 95°, ­ ∠ S = 85°**

questions.q: A boat moves at a speed of 7 km/h in still water. The boat goes 40 km downstream and then 40 km upstream. It is observed that the total time taken for this journey is 560 minutes less than the time it would take if the speed of the stream were 2 km/h faster. What is the initial speed (in km/h) of the stream?
questions.solution:
For stream speed s, total time is 40/(7+s) + 40/(7-s) hours. At s = 3 it is 14 hours; at s + 2 = 5 it is 70/3 hours. Difference = 28/3 hours = 560 minutes, so s = 3 km/h.
**Answer: 3**

questions.q: A shopkeeper purchased 52 dozens of articles at the rate of ₹400 per dozen. He sold each one of them at the rate of ₹58. What percentage profit did he make?
questions.solution:
Cost per item = 400/12 rupees. Profit percentage = [58/(400/12) - 1] × 100 = 74%.
**Answer: 74%**

questions.q: In a business, A, B, and C invest in the ratio 3 : 5 : 4. Out of the total profit, B gives ₹15,000 to A such that A’s share of the profit becomes equal to C’s share. What is the total profit (in ₹) of the business?
questions.solution:
A and C initially get 3 and 4 profit units. Their difference of one unit is ₹15000. Total profit is 12 units = 12 × 15000 = ₹180000.
**Answer: 1,80,000**

questions.q: A shopkeeper fixes the marked price of an item 100% above its cost price. What percentage of discount on marked price should be allowed to gain 2%?
questions.solution:
Marked price is twice cost price. To earn 2% profit, sale price must be 1.02 times cost. Discount fraction = 1 - 1.02/2 = 0.49, or 49%.
**Answer: 49%**

questions.q: A school employs trained and untrained teachers in the ratio 5 : 3. The salaries of a trained and an untrained teachers are in the ratio 4 : 1. If the total salary paid to all teachers in a month is ₹4,60,000, how much total salary is paid to the untrained teachers?
questions.solution:
Total salary weights are 5 × 4 = 20 for trained teachers and 3 × 1 = 3 for untrained. The untrained group receives 3/23 × 460000 = ₹60000.
**Answer: ₹60,000**
